submission.justification: Mixture-G3 at a 2 mm gap gave the best simulated time resolution, 0.858 ns. I scanned 1, 2 and 3 mm for G3 and G1. G3 gave 1.093, 0.858 and 1.025 ns. G1 gave 1.474, 1.303 and 1.51 ns. I did not scan G2 at 2 or 3 mm. At 1 mm it gave 2.274 ns, and the 2025 summary gives 2.0 ns at 2 mm, so it is clearly worse. G3 is the standard fluorinated mixture, so it may be affected by the laboratory's environmental and safety policy. No policy document is in the project files, so I could not check compliance. Someone should check G3 against that policy before adopting it. If G3 is not allowed, the fallback is Mixture-G1 at 2 mm, at 1.303 ns. The 90% recirculation system reduces emissions but does not show compliance.

requirements.evidence: G3 at 2 mm gave 0.858 ns, the lowest of the points I simulated. G3 at 1 and 3 mm gave 1.093 and 1.025 ns. G1 was 1.3 to 1.5 ns. G2 was about 2 ns or worse.

requirements.requirement: Mixture is one of the three candidates
Gas system complies with environmental and safety policies
requirements.evidence: No environmental or safety policy document exists in the project files. G3 is a standard fluorinated mixture and may be restricted. The planned 90% recovery recirculation and the HV compatibility with all mixtures do not establish compliance.
